userStories.title: Add unit test for ensure_scaled with checkpoint restore scenario
acceptanceCriteria: Create test in tests/test_caption_retry_budget.py: test_ensure_scaled_after_checkpoint_restore_with_insufficient_max
Test scenario: budget restored from checkpoint with batch_size=175, max_attempts=100 (config default)
Verify ensure_scaled() detects max_attempts < required (175*2.0=350) and scales up
Verify scaling occurs even when batch_size already matches
Run: pytest tests/test_caption_retry_budget.py::TestEnsureScaledCheckpoint -v --tb=short
Commit: test: [US-43-002] Add test for ensure_scaled checkpoint restore scenario
userStories.notes: Tier 1 (test-first). File: tests/test_caption_retry_budget.py. Created TestEnsureScaledCheckpoint class with 5 tests covering checkpoint restore scenarios. All tests pass - the fix from US-42-004 was already implemented.

userStories.title: Fix ensure_scaled to detect insufficient max_attempts after checkpoint restore
acceptanceCriteria: Modify ensure_scaled() in src/caption/retry_budget.py lines 1103-1217
Add check: if batch_size matches but max_attempts < required_attempts, force scale
Log diagnostic when this scenario is detected: '[US-43-003] Force scaling: batch_size matches but max_attempts insufficient'
Verify test from US-43-002 passes
Run: pytest tests/test_caption_retry_budget.py::TestEnsureScaledCheckpoint -v --tb=short
Commit: fix: [US-43-003] Fix ensure_scaled to detect insufficient max_attempts after checkpoint restore
userStories.notes: Tier 1 (bug fix). File: src/caption/retry_budget.py lines 1158-1164. The condition at line 1158 checks 'batch_size == batch_size' but doesn't verify max_attempts is sufficient. This is likely the root cause of the 100/100 exhaustion.

userStories.title: Add integration test for caption stage checkpoint restore with scaling
acceptanceCriteria: Create test in tests/test_caption_stage.py: test_caption_stage_scales_budget_on_checkpoint_restore
Mock checkpoint with batch_size=175, max_attempts=100, attempts=0
Call caption stage run() with 175 video IDs
Verify retry_budget.max_attempts >= 350 (175 * 2.0)
Run: pytest tests/test_caption_stage.py::test_caption_stage_scales_budget -v --tb=short
Commit: test: [US-43-004] Add integration test for caption stage checkpoint restore scaling
userStories.notes: Tier 2 (integration test). File: tests/test_caption_stage.py. Verifies end-to-end flow from checkpoint restore through scaling.

userStories.title: Add defensive text_metadata initialization in CaptionStage.run()
acceptanceCriteria: Add defensive check at start of CaptionStage.run() in src/stages/caption_stage.py
Check: if not hasattr(state, 'text_metadata') or state.text_metadata is None: state.text_metadata = []
Add this check BEFORE any operations that might use text_metadata
Log warning when this fallback triggers: '[US-43-005] Defensive init: text_metadata was missing/None'
Run: pytest tests/test_caption_stage.py -v --tb=short -x
Commit: fix: [US-43-005] Add defensive text_metadata initialization in CaptionStage.run()
userStories.notes: Tier 1 (defensive fix). File: src/stages/caption_stage.py. The error shows text_metadata doesn't exist on state object. Current defenses in _populate_text_metadata are not catching this - add earlier defense in run().

userStories.title: Add unit test for PipelineState checkpoint deserialization with missing fields
acceptanceCriteria: Create test in tests/test_state.py: test_pipeline_state_deserialize_missing_text_metadata
Test deserializing checkpoint data that lacks 'text_metadata' key
Verify state.text_metadata is [] after deserialization (not None, not missing)
Test both direct construction and checkpoint restore paths
Run: pytest tests/test_state.py::test_pipeline_state_deserialize -v --tb=short
Commit: test: [US-43-006] Add test for PipelineState deserialization with missing fields
userStories.notes: Tier 1 (test). File: tests/test_state.py. The AttributeError indicates text_metadata doesn't exist at all (not just None), which means __post_init__ isn't being called during checkpoint restore.

userStories.title: Fix PipelineState checkpoint restore to call __post_init__
acceptanceCriteria: Investigate checkpoint restore path in src/checkpoint.py restore_state()
Ensure PipelineState.__post_init__() is called after field assignment
Alternative: Add explicit text_metadata=[] in restore_state() field assignments
Verify test from US-43-006 passes
Run: pytest tests/test_state.py tests/test_checkpoint.py -v --tb=short -x
Commit: fix: [US-43-007] Fix PipelineState checkpoint restore to initialize required fields
userStories.notes: Tier 1 (bug fix). Files: src/checkpoint.py, src/state.py. The __post_init__ at state.py:172-177 should handle None text_metadata, but it's not being called during checkpoint restore.

userStories.title: Add log message showing auto_scale decision in ensure_scaled
acceptanceCriteria: Modify ensure_scaled() in src/caption/retry_budget.py
Add INFO log at decision point: 'ensure_scaled: batch_size={}, required={}, current_max={}, will_scale={}'
Log this BEFORE the scaling decision, not just after
Helps diagnose why scaling didn't trigger in production
Run: pytest tests/test_caption_retry_budget.py -v --tb=short
Commit: feat: [US-43-008] Add diagnostic logging to ensure_scaled decision point
userStories.notes: Tier 2 (observability). File: src/caption/retry_budget.py. The logs showed '100/100' but no explanation of why scaling didn't trigger. Adding proactive logging helps future debugging.

userStories.title: Add validation that batch_size is set before ensure_scaled returns
acceptanceCriteria: Modify ensure_scaled() in src/caption/retry_budget.py
Add assertion or warning if batch_size is still None after method completes
Ensure batch_size is ALWAYS set even if scaling is skipped
Add test verifying batch_size is set after ensure_scaled(N) regardless of scaling outcome
Run: pytest tests/test_caption_retry_budget.py::test_ensure_scaled -v --tb=short
Commit: fix: [US-43-009] Ensure batch_size is always set in ensure_scaled
userStories.notes: Tier 1 (robustness). File: src/caption/retry_budget.py. If batch_size is not set, the health check and diagnostic logging can't report correctly.

userStories.title: Add fail-fast check for budget exhaustion before batch start
acceptanceCriteria: Add check in CaptionStage.run() after ensure_scaled() call
If budget_exhausted() is already True, log ERROR and skip batch processing
Log: '[US-43-010] Budget already exhausted at batch start - check checkpoint restore'
Return early with appropriate warnings about skipped videos
Run: pytest tests/test_caption_stage.py -v --tb=short
Commit: fix: [US-43-010] Add fail-fast check for budget exhaustion before batch start
userStories.notes: Tier 2 (fail-fast). File: src/stages/caption_stage.py. If checkpoint restores budget with 100/100 attempts already used, the batch will immediately skip all videos. Better to detect and report this early.
